_comment: RT-FIX-11 (2026-07-25): the CI audit step (.github/workflows/build.yml 'Audit pyrefly baseline changes') now compares the LIVE pyrefly output (pyrefly-current.json, generated by the previous 'Run pyrefly type check' step) against this baseline file's `errors` array. Pre-RT-FIX-11 the audit compared two committed copies of this file (HEAD vs base ref) — both readings came from the same file, so any PR that introduced new type errors but didn't edit this baseline passed silently (163 errors untracked). The fix: NEW_COUNT is read from pyrefly-current.json (live), OLD_COUNT is read from this file at the base ref (the team's accepted floor). The audit fails only when NEW_COUNT > OLD_COUNT. Shrinking the floor requires editing this file in the same PR. RT-FIX-11 also fixed 5 confirmed real type bugs (crash_handler.py:531 bytearray→bytes, templates_handlers.py:70/73 and vocabulary_handlers.py:72/75 str-indexing on error["data"], model_manager.py:374 str.join on list|object, ipc_server.py:576 None→Thread), reducing the live count from 163 to 156.
_justification: The errors array below is the LIVE pyrefly 1.1.1 output against voice_typer/ after RT-FIX-11's 5 type-bug fixes. It is the accepted floor — CI fails only when a PR's live pyrefly output exceeds this count. Categorization of the 156 remaining errors: missing-attribute (mostly platform-specific Windows ctypes / macOS AppKit / VoiceTyperApp attributes that pyrefly cannot resolve on a Linux sandbox), missing-import (platform-only deps not installed in the sandbox: torch, sounddevice, pynput.keyboard, ctranslate2), bad-argument-type, unbound-name, bad-return, bad-index, missing-argument, unsupported-operation, not-callable, bad-assignment, bad-unpacking, no-matching-overload. Most are platform-specific or third-party-library-stub limitations; the few real type bugs should be fixed one-by-one (each fix reduces the count and the audit locks in the gain).
_current_state_2026_07_25_rt_fix_11: RT-FIX-11 ran `pyrefly check voice_typer/ --output-format=json` after fixing the 5 confirmed type bugs. Result: 156 errors (down from 163). The 5 fixed bugs were: (1) crash_handler.py:531 — _write_to_file data param widened from `bytes` to `bytes | bytearray` so the VEH callback can write a `bytearray` slice directly; (2) templates_handlers.py:70,73 and (3) vocabulary_handlers.py:72,75 — narrowed `error["data"]` with `isinstance(_err_data, dict)` before indexing `code`/`message` (pyrefly inferred `error["data"]` as `str | dict` because `_validate_dict_payload` has no return-type annotation and unifies all error branches); (4) model_manager.py:374 — narrowed `_backends` with `isinstance(_backends, list)` before `str.join` (the `callable(_backends)` MagicMock fallback widened the type to `list[str] | object`); (5) ipc_server.py:576 — declared `self._stdin_thread: threading.Thread | None = None` in `__init__` so the `= None` branch in `start()` type-checks (was inferred as `Thread` from the first assignment).
